rationale: The candidate directly and correctly identifies the package-level switch (`cobra.EnablePrefixMatching = true`). This is supported by `cobra.go:55`, which defines `EnablePrefixMatching`, and `command.go:767-786`, where prefix lookup is gated by that flag and succeeds only for one match. Its statement that matching covers command names and aliases is also supported by `command.go:1524-1538`.
